name: rolelimit
author: jenjam
kirin
short: Limit members to one role out of a set.
description: Merges jenjam's colourlimit (keep the newest listed role) and rolelimit (keep the highest listed role). Reads the settings the original cogs saved.
install_msg: Unload and uninstall jencogs' colourlimit and rolelimit before loading this; their settings carry over.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no user data.
